cards.name: Blood Doctor Thal'ena
cards.text: Battlecry:& Get a second Hero Power that costs Corpses.
cards.flavorText: Blood-Princess Thal’ena has been imprisoned for longer than the archmages can remember. Posing as the prison’s doctor, Thal’ena is not content to sate her hunger. Locked in her lab, she is creating something terrifying…

cards.name: Blood Draw
cards.text: Discover a spell. This costs Health instead of Mana.
cards.flavorText: Comes with some moonberry juice so you don't pass out.

cards.name: Blood Tap
cards.text: Give all minions in your hand +1/+1. Spend 2 Corpses to give them +1/+1 more.
cards.flavorText: Come join us in the tavern! We have whatever you're drinking on tap. Yes, even that.

cards.name: Bloodfiend
cards.text: Battlecry: Spend up to 4 Corpses. Deal 1 damage to all other minions for each.
cards.flavorText: "Not much of a looker, is it?" "Oh I assure you, it is."

cards.name: Bloodhoof Brave
cards.text: Taunt Has +3 Attack while damaged.
cards.flavorText: He thought the set was called "Flippers of the Old Cods" and hungrily volunteered to be in it. He is definitely going to get his hearing checked.

cards.name: Bloodmage Thalnos
cards.text: Spell Damage +1 Deathrattle: Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: He's in charge of the Annual Scarlet Monastery Blood Drive!

cards.name: Bloodpetal Biome
cards.text: Discover a Temporary 1-Cost minion.
cards.flavorText: The rash doesn't FEEL temporary.

cards.name: Bloodsail Raider
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain Attack equal to the Attack of your weapon.
cards.flavorText: "I only plunder on days that end in 'y'."

cards.name: Bloodthistle Illusionist
cards.text: Battlecry:& Summon a copy of this. One secretly dies when it takes damage.
cards.flavorText: Some people have imaginary friends. He has an imaginary twin.

cards.name: Blowtorch Saboteur
cards.text: Battlecry: Your opponent's next Hero Power costs (2) more.
cards.flavorText: Before he came along, we went through a lot of duct tape.

cards.name: Body Bagger
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain a Corpse.
cards.flavorText: Gotta get that bag.

cards.name: Bombardment
cards.text: Destroy a random enemy minion and deal 3 damage to the enemy hero. If you control a Mech, do it again.
cards.flavorText: No bombs, no bards, no mints.

cards.name: Bone Flurry
cards.text: Deal 3 damage randomly split among enemies. If a friendly minion died this turn, deal 3 more.
cards.flavorText: Go! Fetch!

cards.name: Bonechill Stegodon
cards.text: Deathrattle: Deal 6 damage to three random enemies.
cards.flavorText: Cold blooded. Bad to the bone. Needs a sweater.

cards.name: Boneguard Commander
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: Raise up to 6 Corpses as 1/3 Risen Footmen with Taunt.
cards.flavorText: Commander? In Hearthstone!? FINALLY!

cards.name: Boomkin
cards.text: Choose One - Restore 8 Health to your hero; or Deal 4 damage.
cards.flavorText: Some Druids consider balance to be a state of harmony between the Natural and the Arcane. Others are more focused on the balance of the opponent’s life total versus their own.

cards.name: Bootleg Alchemist
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand. Transform it into a spell that costs (5) more (keeps its original Cost).
cards.flavorText: Careful! This potion has a bit of a KICK to it!

cards.name: Boulderfist Ogre
cards.flavorText: "ME HAVE GOOD STATS FOR THE COST"

cards.name: Bralma Searstone
cards.text: Your Elementals deal 1 extra damage.
cards.flavorText: She makes a mean molten lava cake.

cards.name: Brash Battlemaster
cards.text: Rush Deathrattle:& Give your Silver Hand Recruits +1 Attack this game.
cards.flavorText: Bold and brash, his enemies belong in the trash.

cards.name: Brassknuckle Brawler
cards.text: Charge Battlecry: If you have 10 or more Armor, gain +4/+4.
cards.flavorText: I didn't hear no bell.

cards.name: Breakout Architect
cards.text: Battlecry:& Discover a spell that costs (5) or more. It casts twice when played.
cards.flavorText: Oh nah, these aren't maps! It's... uh... just arcane hopscotch!

cards.name: Briarspawn Drake
cards.text: At the end of your turn, attack a random enemy minion (excess damage hits the enemy hero).
cards.flavorText: Stop briarspawn-camping!

cards.name: Brightwing
cards.text: Battlecry: Add a random Legendary minion to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Little faerie dragons are made of sugar and spice and maniacal vice.

cards.name: Broll Bearmantle
cards.text: After you cast a spell,& summon a random Animal Companion.
cards.flavorText: That's just how he Brolls.

cards.name: Bronze Keeper
cards.text: At the end of your turn,& summon a 6/6 Elemental Dragon with Divine Shield.
cards.flavorText: I am the Bronze Keeper, Keeper of the Bronze. Nozdormu quivers before him!

cards.name: Bronze Redeemer
cards.text: At the end of your turn,& summon a Dragon with stats equal to this minion's.
cards.flavorText: Paladins use only the highest quality bronzer.

cards.name: Brood Keeper
cards.text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon,& equip a 2/2 Sword.
cards.flavorText: Mess with the brood, and you get the dude!

cards.name: Broodchamber Tunneler
cards.text: Battlecry: Get a 1-Cost Larva with a Combo that triggers a Hero Power from another class.
cards.flavorText: Likes to burrow in datamines.

cards.name: Broodqueen Sha'kar
cards.text: Battlecry: If 5 friendly minions died this turn, your Rush minions have Charge this game. (5 left!)
cards.flavorText: Sha'k it off, Sha'k it off!

cards.name: Broodwatcher
cards.text: Battlecry: Get two 3/3 Whelps with Taunt. If you spent 8 Mana while holding this, summon them. ( left!) Battlecry: Get two 3/3 Whelps with Taunt. If you spent 8 Mana while holding this, summon them. (Ready!) Battlecry: Get two 3/3 Whelps with Taunt. If you spent 8 Mana while holding this, summon them.
cards.flavorText: A watched brood never hatches!

cards.name: Broxigar
cards.text: Fabled, Charge Start of Game: Disappear. Kill all 4 Demons from Argus to reappear in hand.
cards.flavorText: The wound Broxigar dealt to Sargeras during his last stand is a glory no other orcish hero has ever achieved.

cards.name: Broxigar's Last Stand
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to all minions. Draw a card for each that died.
cards.flavorText: Azshara thought she'd have no trouble overwhelming Darkshore's defenders. But last stands are a specialty of Broxigar's in any timeline.

cards.name: Brutish Endmaw
cards.text: Battlecry:& Discover a 1-Cost minion with a Dark Gift.
cards.flavorText: Et tu, Brute?

cards.name: Bugsquasher
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to an enemy minion with a minion type.
cards.flavorText: The Tortollans would be nothing without their QA department.

cards.name: Bulwark of Azzinoth
cards.text: Whenever your hero would take damage, this loses 1 Durability instead.
cards.flavorText: This plate turned shield you shall wield, praying its powers fel will serve you well.

cards.name: Bursting Leyline
cards.text: Deal damage to a random enemy minion. Excess damage hits the enemy hero. Deal damage to a random enemy minion, times. Excess damage hits the enemy hero.
cards.flavorText: When you gotta go, you gotta go.

cards.name: Bursting Shot
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to three random enemies.
cards.flavorText: And I fired! And I missed. And I fired again! And I missed again. This went on for several hours.

cards.name: Bygone Doomspeaker
cards.text: Rewind Battlecry: Both players discard a random card.
cards.flavorText: Let bygones be Doomspeakers.

cards.name: Bygone Echoes
cards.text: Summon a random 4-Cost minion. Spend 4 Corpses to summon another. Outcast: And another.
cards.flavorText: Let bygones be bygones... be bygones... be bygones...

cards.name: C'Thun, Eye of the Empire
cards.text: Old God. If you've triggered all 4 C'Thun abilities this game, this minion's abilities are tripled.
cards.flavorText: "Amitut, Keeper of Amitus"/2 + (2*"Incubate")/2 + (2*"The Unknowable One"/3)

cards.name: Caged Cranium
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry:& Gain +1 Health for each card in your hand.
cards.flavorText: "NYEH HEH HEH!"

cards.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
cards.text: Taunt Deathrattle:& Summon a 5/5 Baine Bloodhoof.
cards.flavorText: Cairne was killed by Garrosh, so... don't put this guy in a Warrior deck. It's pretty insensitive.

cards.name: Calia Menethil
cards.text: Battlecry: Resurrect your highest-Cost minion that died this game.
cards.flavorText: Calia Menethil, last heir of the Menethil line, was slain at the Gathering on Sylvanas’s orders. Later resurrected by Alonsus Faol with Anduin’s aid through a unique Light‑based undeath, she now serves as a bridge between the living and the Forsaken.

cards.name: Call of the Wild
cards.text: Summon all three Animal Companions.
cards.flavorText: "Hello. Misha, Leokk and Huffer aren't here right now, but if you leave a message we'll get back to you right away." BEEP.

cards.name: Cannonmaster
cards.text: Battlecry: Get a 1/1 Cannoneer that deals 1 damage to a random enemy at end of turn.
cards.flavorText: Just watch his hour long video to understand all the Hearthstone lore.

cards.name: Captain Crowley
cards.text: Your Cannoneers fire an additional shot. Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Cannoneers.
cards.flavorText: The coward Godfrey had hidden in Shadowfang Keep for long enough. Darius didn’t care whom he had to work with. Mercenaries… pirates… all that mattered was justice.

cards.name: Captive Nathrezim
cards.text: Prepare, Taunt ALL minions cost (2) more.
cards.flavorText: All he needs is a feather to escape.

cards.name: Captured Archmage
cards.text: Deathrattle: If you had 4 other Captured Archmages die this game, cast 'Fireball' at a random enemy. ( /4)
cards.flavorText: Step One: Die. Step Two: Perish. Step Three: Pass away. Step Four: Bite the dust. Steps Five-Ten: FIREBALL!

cards.name: Carrier Whelp
cards.text: Battlecry:& Get a random Dragon that costs (3) or less.
cards.flavorText: So that's where baby dragons come from...

cards.name: Cataclysmic War Axe
cards.text: Battlecry: Herald Ragnaros.
cards.flavorText: Almost too hot to handle.

cards.name: Caustic Fumes
cards.text: Destroy an enemy minion. Kindred: Deal 2 damage to all minions.
cards.flavorText: If the fumes don't get them, the fumes might.

cards.name: Cease to Exist
cards.text: Rewind Silence and destroy a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.

cards.name: Ceremonial Clash
cards.text: Summon a random 3, 2, and 1-Cost minion. Overload: (1)
cards.flavorText: The only ceremony that matters.

cards.name: Chainbreaker Hogger
cards.text: Taunt Start of Game: Duplicate all other Legendary cards in your deck.
cards.flavorText: Inmate Intake 031306. Reason for arrest: Ate too many noobs.

cards.name: Chamber of Aspects
cards.text: Choose a minion in your hand. Give it +2/+2.
cards.flavorText: Always keep one in the chamber.

cards.name: Chaos Strike
cards.text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: "What do we want?" "CHAOS!" "When do we want it?" "WHEN LEAST EXPECTED!"

cards.name: Chaos Supplicant
cards.text: After you cast a spell, cast a random spell of the same Cost from another class.
cards.flavorText: Witness him on one knee, begging RNG to work in his favor.

cards.name: Charity
cards.text: Get copies of all friendly minions that died this turn. Give them +3/+3.
cards.flavorText: I am donating these minions... to myself!

cards.name: Charred Chameleon
cards.text: Battlecry: If you've used your Hero Power this turn, give a friendly minion +1/+2 and Rush.
cards.flavorText: Charma, charma, charma, charma, charma chameleon You combust and glow, you combust and glow...

cards.name: Chef Neth'rek
cards.text: Start of Game: If your deck only has cards that cost (3) or less, set your Mana to 10 after five turns!
cards.flavorText: Neth’rek was the leader of a small Nerubian settlement - but that was before the Lich King came. Appearing content with her life as head chef, the wardens have forgotten to see her as a threat…

cards.name: Chillfallen Baron
cards.text: Battlecry and Deathrattle:& Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: He hates when people call 60 degree weather cold.

cards.name: Chillmaw
cards.text: Taunt Deathrattle: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 3 damage to all minions.
cards.flavorText: Chillmaw keeps trying to ruin the Grand Tournament, and she would've done it too, if it weren't for those dang kids!

cards.name: Chillspine Stegodon
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to two random enemy minions. Kindred: And Freeze them.
cards.flavorText: I'm freezin' my tail off over here!

cards.name: Chisel
cards.text: Assemble a Taunt minion. Give it +2/+3.
cards.flavorText: Look at your marble. Visualize the sculpture within. And gently...

cards.name: Cho'gall, Mastermind
cards.text: Colossal +2 Your Arms and Soldiers destroy minions in the enemy's deck instead.
cards.flavorText: Once a servant of the Old Gods, Cho'gall believes he has become a god, worthy to stand beside them.

cards.name: Chow Down
cards.text: Summon five 5/4 Undead Drakes. Spend 8 Corpses to give them Rush.
cards.flavorText: Oh look! Another seasoned adventurer...

cards.name: Chromatic Broodmother
cards.text: Rush Whenever this attacks,& refresh Mana Crystals equal to this minion's Attack.
cards.flavorText: Bring ALL your Resist armor.

cards.name: Chromatus
cards.text: Colossal +4 Taunt, Lifesteal, Elusive, Divine Shield
cards.flavorText: In our timeline, Nefarius never achieved his dream of combining the power of all five dragonflights into a single ultimate dragon. But Murozond found the timeline where he did.

cards.name: Chromie
cards.text: Deathrattle: Draw another copy of cards you've played this game. ( (card,cards))
cards.flavorText: Chromie searched far and wide, but there just wasn’t a group of heroes with the strength to take down Murozond. In this timeline, at least…

cards.name: Chronicle Keeper
cards.text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon,& gain Taunt and Divine Shield.
cards.flavorText: No retcon required!

cards.name: Chronikar
cards.text: Battlecry: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn, next turn, and the turn after.
cards.flavorText: And the next turn! And the next turn!

cards.name: Chrono Daggers
cards.text: Rewind Throw 3 knives at random enemies that deal 2 damage each.
cards.flavorText: Ow. Ow. Ow. No no not again! Ow. Ow. Ow.

cards.name: Chrono-Lord Deios
cards.text: Your Battlecries, Deathrattles, Hero Power, and end of turn effects trigger twice.
cards.flavorText: Deiiiiios. Deiiii eiiii eiii os.

cards.name: Chrono-Lord Epoch
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy all minions that your opponent played last turn.
cards.flavorText: Epoch? But he's Legendary!

cards.name: Chronochiller
cards.text: You no longer draw a card at the start of your turn.
cards.flavorText: Time always seems to pass quickly when you just want to chill.

cards.name: Chronoclaws
cards.text: After your hero attacks, discard your highest Cost card.
cards.flavorText: Perfect for ripping apart the timeline.

cards.name: Chronogor
cards.text: Battlecry: You draw your 2 highest Cost cards. Your opponent draws your 2 lowest Cost cards.
cards.flavorText: "I'm flight-ready!" "I'm not flight-ready!"

cards.name: Chronological Aura
cards.text: At the end of your turn, summon a 3/5 Dragon with Taunt. Lasts turns.
cards.flavorText: We need to find the missing dragon link!

cards.name: Cinderfin
cards.text: Deathrattle:& Summon a 2/1 Sizzling Cinder.
cards.flavorText: "Don't play with fire." "But they're my friends!"

cards.name: Cindersword
cards.text: Battlecry: If you're holding a minion with a Dark Gift, gain +3 Attack.
cards.flavorText: Where did I put de metals? It cindersword.

cards.name: Circadiamancer
cards.text: Battlecry: Add a random 8-Cost minion to your hand. At the start of your turns, reduce its Cost by (1).
cards.flavorText: "I'm my OWN alarm clock."

cards.name: City Chief Esho
cards.text: Battlecry: If every minion in your deck shares a minion type, give your other minions +2/+2 (wherever they are).
cards.flavorText: "Let me esho you around!"

cards.name: City Defenses
cards.text: Summon two 0/6 Security with Taunt. They gain +1 Attack when damaged.
cards.flavorText: These 0/6 Taunts have kept invaders out for centuries.

cards.name: Cleansing Cleric
cards.text: Battlecry: Your healing effects restore 2 more Health this game.
cards.flavorText: Ah yes. Your "healing" effects. Sure thing.

cards.name: Cleansing Lightspawn
cards.text: Lifesteal Battlecry: Deal damage to an enemy minion equal to this minion's Health.
cards.flavorText: To get out the toughest stains, mix baking soda, vinegar, and the scorching rays of atonement.

cards.name: Clockwork Boars
cards.text: Summon two 1/1 Mech Beasts with Charge.
cards.flavorText: Clear cultists from your backyard in seconds, just wind 'em up and let 'em go!

cards.name: Clockwork Rager
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Health for each turn you've taken this game. ( (turn, turns))
cards.flavorText: "BY MY CALCULATIONS YOU ARE TWO MINUTES LATE!!!"

cards.name: Cloud Serpent
cards.text: Battlecry: Get a copy of another Elemental or Dragon in your hand.
cards.flavorText: Cloudy with a chance of Quest Rewards.

cards.name: Clutch of Corruption
cards.text: Choose a friendly Dragon. Summon a 0/2 Egg that hatches into a copy of it.
cards.flavorText: These eggs are no yolk!

cards.name: Code Violet
cards.text: Prepare. Summon an 8-Cost minion. If you've cast 3 other spells this turn, do it again. ( left!) (Ready!)
cards.flavorText: Above Code Red but just below Code Ultraviolet.

cards.name: Coghammer
cards.text: Battlecry: Give a random friendly minion Divine Shield and Taunt.
cards.flavorText: So you ripped this out of a machine, carved some runes on it, stuck it on a handle, and now it's a weapon of great divine power? Seems legit.

cards.name: Coilbearer
cards.text: Battlecry: Discover a spell to put on top of your deck. It costs (2) less.
cards.flavorText: Always complains about getting topdecked.

cards.name: Cold Snap
cards.text: Freeze an enemy. Get a random Frost spell.
cards.flavorText: Oh snappers!

cards.name: Coldlight Seer
cards.text: Battlecry: Give your other Murlocs +2 Health.
cards.flavorText: The Coldlight murlocs reside in the darkest pits of the Abyssal Depths. So no, there's no getting away from murlocs.

cards.name: Command Claw
cards.text: After your hero attacks, give a random friendly minion +2 Attack.
cards.flavorText: Cmd + Claw + Delete

cards.name: Commander Beatrix
cards.text: Taunt While building your deck, pick a 2-Cost minion. Ten copies join your deck!
cards.flavorText: The crimes of the Scarlet Crusade had become too great for Azeroth to ignore. Behind bars, Beatrix has taken over a wing of the prison with her fellow crusaders, demanding that the mages give them an incantation to disable the Hold’s defenses.

cards.name: Commander Geddon
cards.text: Battlecry: Instead of drawing each turn, Discover a card from your deck. It costs (3) less. Destroy the others.
cards.flavorText: TWO THIRDS WILL BURN!!

cards.name: Commissary Crook
cards.text: Prepare Battlecry: Spend all your Mana. Summon a random minion of that Cost.
cards.flavorText: If a headache you’ve got, a headache Commissary Crook can cure. Drink this blue one.

cards.name: Concealing Confection
cards.text: Deathrattle: Get a random weapon.
cards.flavorText: You can have your cake and attack with it too!

cards.name: Conflagrate
cards.text: Deal 5 damage to a minion. Its owner draws a card.
cards.flavorText: From the ashes, a new card is drawn.

cards.name: Conflux Crasher
cards.text: Rewind Battlecry: Deal 7 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: Conflexing on my haters.

cards.name: Confront the Tol'vir
cards.text: Summon each 1-Cost minion you've played this game.
cards.flavorText: You better be careful or else I'll unleash my tiny army!

cards.name: Conjuration Specialist
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a spell in your hand. Split it into two random spells of the same Cost.
cards.flavorText: Specialist is a very polite way of saying she only knows one spell.

cards.name: Conjured Bookkeeper
cards.text: Deathrattle: Draw a spell. Kindred:& Summon a copy of this.
cards.flavorText: In charge of cleaning up after the Library Rager.

cards.name: Consecration
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavorText: Consecrated ground glows with Holy energy. But it smells a little, too.

cards.name: Constellar's Calling
cards.text: Choose a friendly minion. Summon a random minion of the same Cost.
cards.flavorText: Constellar spam calls about installing astral energy panels became an annoyance all throughout the cosmos.

cards.name: Consumption
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to two random enemy minions. Draw a card for each that dies.
cards.flavorText: Consumption Junction, what's your function?

cards.name: Contingency
cards.text: Draw the bottom two cards from your deck.
cards.flavorText: Straight to Plan Z!

cards.name: Contraband Wands
cards.text: Get 3 Arcane Missiles.
cards.flavorText: The cake is a lie.

cards.name: Convalescence
cards.text: Summon two Silver Hand Recruits with Divine Shield.
cards.flavorText: Get WELL MET soon!

cards.name: Corpse Cannon
cards.text: After your hero attacks,& summon a 1/1 Frail Ghoul.
cards.flavorText: LET THE BODIES HIT THE BOARD!

cards.name: Corpse Farm
cards.text: Spend up to 8 Corpses to summon a random minion of that Cost.
cards.flavorText: It ain't much, but it's dishonest work.

cards.name: Corpse Flower
cards.text: After your opponent summons a minion, spend 2 Corpses to deal 3 damage to it.
cards.flavorText: Sometimes it's better not to stop and smell the flowers.

cards.name: Corrupt Constable
cards.text: Battlecry: If the enemy deck has any Imp-formants, move one to the top and give it +2/+2.
cards.flavorText: "In spite of the rumors, we continue in our proud tradition of not having a functioning justice system in the city of Gadgetzan." - Mayor Noggenfogger

cards.name: Corrupted Ashbringer
cards.text: Lifesteal
cards.flavorText: Put your faith in the blight!

cards.name: Cosmic Manifestations
cards.text: Deal 2 damage. Shuffle a random Demon Hunter spell into your deck. Outcast: Do it again.
cards.flavorText: I did NOT manifest this.

cards.name: Cosmic Springs
cards.text: Draw a card. If it's not a minion, refresh two Mana Crystals.
cards.flavorText: You can be my Cosmic Spriiinnnngggssss.

cards.name: Costume Merchant
cards.text: Battlecry: Get a random Mask from another class. Combo: It costs (2) less.
cards.flavorText: Every fall, this tortollan rents out the abandoned shellshop.

cards.name: Counterspell
cards.text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, Counter it.
cards.flavorText: What's the difference between a mage playing with Counterspell and a mage who isn't? The mage who isn't is getting Pyroblasted in the face.

cards.name: Cower in Fear
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. The next Beast you play this turn costs (2) less.
cards.flavorText: Mother Duck's fourth duckling got lost in Un'Goro Crater.

cards.name: Crackling Cloudstrider
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a spell in your hand that costs (4) or less to absorb. Deathrattle: Cast it.
cards.flavorText: Stride, crackle, and Prepare to get popped.

cards.name: Crater Experiment
cards.text: Kindred: Summon a copy of this.
cards.flavorText: Finally, a dinosaur designed by committee.

cards.name: Crater Gator
cards.text: Battlecry: Until the start of your next turn, the enemy hero can't be healed.
cards.flavorText: See ya later Crater Gator!

cards.name: Crazed Alchemist
cards.text: Battlecry: Swap the Attack and Health of a minion.
cards.flavorText: "You'll love my new recipe!" he says... especially if you're not happy with your current number of limbs.

cards.name: Crazed Chemist
cards.text: Combo: Give a friendly minion +4 Attack.
cards.flavorText: You don't have to be crazy to work here, but it helps.

cards.name: Creature of Madness
cards.text: Battlecry: Discover a 3-Cost minion with a Dark Gift.
cards.flavorText: So THIS is madness!

cards.name: Creature of the Sacred Cave
cards.text: At the end of your turn, recast a random Holy spell you cast this turn (targets this if possible).
cards.flavorText: Really likes being read to.

cards.name: Cremate
cards.text: Discover a minion with a Dark Gift. It costs (2) less.
cards.flavorText: Cleanup on grave plot 4.

cards.name: Crimson Sigil Runner
cards.text: Outcast:& Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: He's not the fastest of the bunch, but he'll take a stab at it anyway.

cards.name: Critter Caretaker
cards.text: At the end of your turn,& restore 3 Health to both heroes.
cards.flavorText: She teaches all her critters two things: heel and heal.

cards.name: Crowd Control
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all minions, twice. If your deck has 25 or more cards, this costs (2) less.
cards.flavorText: What type? Stun? Sleep? Sheep?

cards.name: Crumblecrusher
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy a random enemy minion, location, and weapon.
cards.flavorText: If you give a Dragon a cookie, next he'll want a minion, weapon, and location.

cards.name: Cryofrozen Champion
cards.text: Deathrattle:& Get a random Legendary minion. Reduce its Cost by (1).
cards.flavorText: If you keep making that face it's going to freeze like that.

cards.name: Cryosleep
cards.text: Deal 4 damage and draw a card. Kindred: Draw another.
cards.flavorText: You mad? Cryobout it.

cards.name: Crypt Map
cards.text: Discover a Frost Rune card. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
cards.flavorText: Solving a maze is easy. Just hug the left wall and don't get eaten by dinosaurs!

cards.name: Crystal Merchant
cards.text: If you have any unspent Mana at the end of your turn, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: I won't ask about your mana curve if you don't ask where I got these.

cards.name: Crystal Tender
cards.text: Tradeable Battlecry: Gain empty Mana Crystals until both players have the same Mana.
cards.flavorText: "Hands off my tendies!"

cards.name: Crystal Tusk
cards.text: Battlecry: Shuffle the left- most card in your hand into your deck. Deathrattle: Draw 2 cards.
